title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E07 — Hunting a Big Score
Hunter takes on the arctic tundra when a geologist's lead points to crazy gold on the edge of the Hoffman claim; Andy works to turn pay dirt from an ancient river channel into a big payoff.

title: Hoffman Family Gold
description:
S01 E08 — The Mother Lode
The Hoffmans discover a huge vein of gold that could save their season if they can get it out of the ground in time; as the mine equipment fails, pressure mounts on their mechanic, Randy, to keep it all running.

title: Gold Rush
description:
Top Ten Fan-Favorite Moments
Join us for a countdown of Gold Rush fans' top 10 favorite moments across fifteen seasons of Gold Rush. Which one will be Number One?

title: Gold Rush
description:
When Parker Met Rick
Rick Ness takes a job working on 16-year-old Parker Schnabel's gold mine; the two miners form a strong bond, bringing in millions in gold, but a falling-out changes everything.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E04 — Disaster in Denver
Mountain Recovery faces a tight deadline to recover a semi in a Denver water reservoir; high winds roll over a hauler carrying groceries through Wyoming.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E05 — Ain't Worth Dying For
As a record-breaking windstorm hits Wyoming, recovery crews work side by side in hurricane-force winds to right rolled semis and clear the interstate; an icy path around Utah Lake overturns a loaded dump truck.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E07 — Spinning Out on I-80
A windstorm near Salt Lake City overturns a semi with a mystery load; a hauler with a heavy-duty load of data center cooling units spins out of control on I-80; Mountain Recovery's rookie operator fights a multi-front battle.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S03 E09 — Home Is Where the Gold Is
A family sells everything to purchase a 150-acre gold-rich property to mine and homestead; as their families grow, their gold production does not; shutdowns and broken equipment send Freddy and Juan's plans off track, forcing all-new ingenuity.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S03 E10 — Gold Habits Die Hard
A struggling Oregon miner brings in Freddy and Juan to double his gold, which will convince best friend Terry to invest in his Oregon mine; the duo proposes a radical fix, but they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E09 — Taming the Monster
Freddy and Juan find a struggling miner who put his entire life savings into 288 claims in Arizona to create a legacy for his grandson.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E05 — Low-Grade Panic
Rick hires an engineer to see if he can mine again this season; Parker's crew struggles to keep four plants running; Tony tries to double his gold.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E06 — Rivers of Gold
Rick prospects new ground on Duncan Creek; Tony tasks Nick to deliver their biggest haul of the year; Buzz finds a feeder to increase production.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E07 — Black Gold
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut; Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing; Greg and Buzz decode some black pay dirt.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E08 — Carrying Parker's Water
Parker's team tries a wild plan to resupply their water; Tony struggles with a rock truck driver; Rick gets test results on his Snake River cut.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E09 — Icy Hot Mess
A virus rips through Parker's camp; Tony's son Mike breaks through icy overburden at the Hester Cut; Buzz buys an ancient trommel buried in the bush.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E08 — The 300-Foot Drop
A once-in-a-lifetime recovery of a mangled truck 300 feet down the sheer drop of the San Juan mountains puts Mountain Recovery on edge.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E08 — All Slot and Bothered
A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests; a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: Gold Rush: White Water
description:
S09 E10 — Winter Waits for No Man
As winter starts to show its teeth, Dustin and his crew fight to find bedrock and the $100,000 in gold he needs to avoid selling his claims; a burnt-out winch causes rocks to pile up in the dive hole increasing tensions between Dustin and Danielle.

title: Along Central Asia's Great Rivers
description:
S01 E02 — The Disappearing Sea
Arriving at the dry seabed of the shrinking Aral Sea, Kate makes the first-ever bicycle journey around its shores.

title: Live to Farm
description:
S04 E09
Go inside the lives of America's top farmers as they navigate the challenges, risks and rewards of modern agriculture; from planting to harvest, follow real farming families as they work to produce the food that feeds the world.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E19 — Service Without a Smile
Serving others is a noble cause, unless it's in the service industry; between bad customers and broken machines, it can be a total nightmare.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E18 — Trains, Planes and Flying Fists
By land, air, rail or sea -- with so many ways to travel, one'd think it would be a breeze; but leave it to fellow travelers to bring one to one's knees, causing unexpected turmoil along the way.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E10 — Fightin' 9 to 5
The average person spends nearly 90,000 hours of their life at work; from contractor showdowns and unexpected explosions to battling coworkers, a workday feels like an epic rollercoaster ride.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E13 — Grand Theft Viral
When jewel thieves get stuck in a shop, a fleeing carjacker hides in a port-a-potty, and a criminal tries to escape in a 20-ton construction vehicle, the law fights back and puts them behind bars.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E03 — Security Cam Chaos
Security cameras in front yards, backyards, storefronts and street corners capture crimes, mishaps and earth-shattering moments like break-ins. When lives are at risk, it is up to local law enforcement and communities to save the day.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E09 — Insane on a Plane
In the world of air travel, crime and misconduct are skyrocketing, causing unruly travelers to be denied boarding; protesting passengers create turbulence for everyone on board; when mechanical issues arise, the real chaos begins.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E12 — Holidays From Hell
Holidays highlight unique traditions, but when clashing personalities and lots of alcohol get mixed, mayhem and memorable stories are sure to follow.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E16 — Retail Fails
Shopping trips are part of everyone's daily routines, but if tensions flare between angry customers and fed-up workers, it can result in more than just damaged goods.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E04 — Nightmare on Fremont Street
A rookie security manager on his first graveyard shift struggles to keep up with an escalating barrage of bizarre calls, ringing one after another; meanwhile, a late-night VIP pickup turns into a cross-town odyssey full of unexpected detours.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E02 — Big Bang Theories
Reports of loud bangs and bullet holes on the eighth floor spark a tense night before the cause of the chaos is discovered one floor above.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E07 — Fifty Shades of Gray
With unprecedented access, the Golden Nugget reveals the hidden world behind a Las Vegas hotel and casino, where a larger-than-life team of security, surveillance, operations and VIP hosts manage the chaos of wild guest requests and bad behavior.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E05 — Till Death Do Us Shark
Four unique weddings in one day stretch the Golden Nugget's wedding team to their limit; a crack in the 200,000-gallon shark tank raises the alarm; stolen casino keys cause chaos; security breaks up a rowdy wedding party of seniors.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E06 — Double Downed
The annual blackjack tournament lures more than big money to the Nugget; it becomes an opportunity to nab notorious thieves.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E08 — All Slot and Bothered
A high roller demands the return of his favorite slot machine as security goes undercover to catch hustlers targeting casino guests; a poolside confrontation spirals out of control, stretching the Golden Nugget team thin.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E05 — Great Lakes' Vanished Warships
Diving into Lake Superior, Josh has brand-new intel that may finally solve a 100-year-old mystery: the resting place of two WW1 minesweepers; on their way to combat German mines in the Atlantic, the warships sank and took the lives of 79 sailors.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E10 — Chasing Everglades Treasure
Josh digs deep into the swamp to hunt the lost fortune of notorious bootleggers and bank robbers the Ashley Gang; Josh needs to retrace the outlaw family's criminal empire, which included a blood feud with the local Florida sheriff.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S08 E03 — The Hunt for Our Ancient Ancestors
In a two-part investigation, Josh Gates travels the globe attempting to solve the most fundamental mystery of all humanity's origins.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S08 E04 — Revealing Our Ancient Ancestors
Josh Gates travels to Africa to get up close and personal with a distant relative and scales dangerous cliffs all to figure out where humans come from.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E07 — Lost Tomb of the Viking King
Josh chases the treasure of legendary Viking Harald Bluetooth Gormsson; the discovery of a mysterious gold artifact sends Josh on a journey through Scandinavia and into remote northern European forests to uncover Bluetooth's tomb and fortune.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E06 — Sunken Treasure of the Bahamas
Josh helps recover the richest stash of lost treasure in the Americas; deploying cutting-edge technology and an armada of boats, the team dives the Caribbean to bring coins and jewels from the legendary Spanish galleon Maravillas to the surface.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E04 — The Quest for El Dorado
Josh Gates treks into Colombia's deadly jungle to unravel the El Dorado myth and retrace the steps of Spanish conquistadors; Josh meets with the tribe that inspired the legend of a city of gold and unearths its treasure in a surprising location.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S09 E05 — Uncovering the Golden City
The hunt for El Dorado is Josh's most grueling journey ever, and one of the crew tumbles into a raging river; when cutting-edge aerial scans reveal a lost city, the crew pushes into the jungle to uncover El Dorado and the gold that comes with it.

title: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
description:
S01 E02 — Rookie Mistakes
Dozer Dave bets his life savings that he can unearth piles of gold from an abandoned mine using salvaged equipment and a team of amateur miners.

title: Gold Rush: Dave Turin's Lost Mine
description:
S01 E03 — Paydirt Mystery
Dave faces a nightmare scenario when the ground he's mining goes cold and no one knows why; with his season hanging in the balance, the pressure mounts for Dave to get them back on the gold.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E07 — Shiner Patriot
For America's 250th anniversary, Tim and Tickle produce revolutionary-era moonshine; Digger questions Mark's attempt at his ancestor's sour corn whiskey; Josh and Jerry's plans fail.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E08 — Mash Bill of Rights
As Tim and Tickle add molasses to their 18th-century mash bill and heat their vintage copper still with wood fire, Howard takes the revolutionary spirit too far. Demand for Josh's shine outpaces supply as Jerry opens a new front in his war with Mike.

title: Guided: The Reel Story of Louisiana Guides
description:
S01 E03
Captures the skill, determination and passion it takes to succeed in one of Louisiana's most demanding outdoor professions; from predawn starts and the relentless search for fish to battling Mother Nature, these guides face pressure every day.

title: Tomorrow's World Today
description:
S10 E08 — Forging the Future
George sends Greg to the World of Innovation for a behind-the-scenes look at a modern steelmaking facility, where cutting-edge technology and a new generation of skilled professionals are transforming one of America's most essential industries.

description:
S17 E09 — Icy Hot Mess

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E06 — Tornado of the Year
Every year tornado junkies descend on America's tornado alley; these storm chasers put everything on the line to prove they're the best in the game.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E01 — Twister Shapeshifter
Near Gary, S.D., expert chasers and certified weather spotters self-shoot an encounter with a long-track, shape-shifting tornado; when the twister takes a turn towards an occupied farmhouse, chasers are thrust into the role of first responders.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E03 — Danger Close in Dakota
Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley; they self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way and help save lives when disaster strikes.

title: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
description:
S01 E02 — Mile-Wide EF5
Six teams of chasers pursue a violent tornado outbreak in North Dakota; but as day turns to night, the storm unleashes the first EF5 tornado in over a decade; as the mile-wide monster levels homes and farms, chasers race to rescue people and pets.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E05 — Savage Strategies
Matt's tactics spark tension in another camp; survivalists compete in a primitive axe challenge; after the first big-game kill, a competitor must choose to keep or share their win; physical and mental strain of the challenge sends a survivalist home.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E06 — Down Under Siege
Pushed to the brink, three competitors send shockwaves through the Outback; all camps are disbanded and challenges going forward will be solo tests; hunting competition offers a protein reward; medics are called when a survivalist steps on hot coals.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E07 — Bringing the Heat and the Meat
In a rocket stove challenge, a worst-to-first comeback by a dark horse secures a critical asset; a survivalist gets a big-game kill and plots to shift the balance of power; a top contender's shocking exit rocks the competition.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E08 — Flame on or Flame Out
The friction fire challenge shakes everyone; Patrick is stunned when he must give up his gathered materials; Cheeny has an edge, but her strategy risks it all; Matt's blistered hands could send him home; one survivalist is eliminated.

title: Naked and Afraid: Last One Standing
description:
S03 E09 — Three Dog Fight to the Finish
With the $100,000 prize on the line, the final gauntlet of challenges tests each survivalist's bushcraft, bow and fire-making skills; the competition is neck-and-neck, with all three competitors seconds from claiming the title of Last One Standing.

title: Legendary Locations
description:
S01 E10 — Secrets in Stone
Josh explores three legendary locations where stone labyrinths hide something incredible, including a vast city carved deep into a canyon in the Jordanian desert and a South Pacific cave once used as a kitchen by a cannibal tribe.

title: Bering Sea Gold
description:
S17 E10 — A Murky Future
Shawn hunts for a new spot as the fleet tries to pick up the pieces after the devastating storm; Chris faces horrible visibility issues underwater; Team Emily manages to get back on the gold, and Reaper Nation tries to salvage their season.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S04 E02 — Justice Served
On Lake Sam Rayburn, a water patrol turns into a cry for help; the wardens serve a warrant to a man who illegally shot a hog; a drug arrest leads a game warden into a manhunt.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S04 E04 — Seeing Stars and Stripes
It's summertime in Texas and the game wardens handle a speeding jet ski, drunk boaters, angry campers and a rowdy raccoon.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S04 E05 — Crash Course
A feisty gator in Galveston County needs a new home; shrimpers try to conceal their catch; a family's property is damaged by stray bullets; the wardens stage a boat crash.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S04 E03 — Back Road Bait
It's snapper season on the Gulf and the game wardens catching fishermen who are breaking the law; two men are investigated for cruelty to a wild pig; a jet ski collision leads to arguments; an exotic tortoise finds a new home.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S04 E09 — Fawn Stars
In Liberty County, the death of a deer is investigated; fawns in Harris County are being illegally kept as pets; patrol on Somerville Lake leads to multiple citations; a suspicious car is stopped in Red River County.
